title: WebAssembly build
what: The script that makes the package's WebAssembly build: the crate compiled for the browser, the binding's glue and types, the optimised bytes in a JavaScript module and the source hash (package/build.ts).

title: JavaScript semantics
what: How the crate counts, spaces, trims and reads numbers as JavaScript does, so the crate and the package give one answer for one input (src/js.rs).

title: WebAssembly binding
what: The binding every package module calls through, and its loader: each export takes the package's arguments, calls a reading and writes the answer in the package's shape (src/wasm/mod.rs, package/binding.ts).
